name: lead_temperature
description: Classify only from stated timing and next-step intent.

name: purchase_timeline
description: When the caller expects to buy or decide; blank if not stated.

name: budget_amount
description: Exact caller-stated amount only; blank if none.

name: family_or_passenger_need
description: Passenger, child-seat, pet, cargo, accessibility, or towing need.

name: preferred_body_style
description: Preferred or accepted body styles stated or confirmed by the caller.

name: recommended_stock_ids
description: Comma-separated stock IDs actually mentioned by Avery.

name: appointment_requested
description: True only if the caller requested or accepted a visit.

name: appointment_booked
description: True only after the booking tool returned success.

name: appointment_datetime
description: Confirmed slot including America/Chicago timezone; blank otherwise.

name: handoff_required
description: True when financing, negotiation, trade-in valuation, complaint, direct human request, or unresolved issue needs a person.

name: call_summary
description: Three factual sentences for a salesperson: customer need, grounded recommendation, and next-step outcome.
